hebrewText: כַּנְפֵי֙ הַ/כְּרוּבִ֣ים הָ/אֵ֔לֶּה פֹּֽרְשִׂ֖ים אַמּ֣וֹת עֶשְׂרִ֑ים וְ/הֵ֛ם עֹמְדִ֥ים עַל רַגְלֵי/הֶ֖ם וּ/פְנֵי/הֶ֥ם לַ/בָּֽיִת

break, chop in pieces, lay open, scatter, spread (abroad, forth, selves, out), stretch (forth, out).

it, like, [idiom] (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, [idiom] so, [idiom] such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.
